parsed.refutation_attempt: I examined the code for any untrusted data sources. The only values used in the bind call are the hard‑coded IP address string in line 31 and the hard‑coded port number in line 30. No input from stdin, argv, environment variables, network, IPC, or any public API is read or parsed, so there is no source of untrusted data that could reach the bind syscall. Furthermore, the bind function does not invoke an OS command, it simply passes the address structure to the kernel; therefore even if the data were user‑controlled it would not result in command injection. No checks are required to neutralize command special characters, because the code never constructs a command line. The reported “trigger” on line 33 is simply a normal bind call with constant arguments. Hence the vulnerability claim is unfounded.
